title: Payment Processing unavailable - storage array failover
description: Primary storage array controller failure caused Payment Processing database volumes to go read-only. Payments unavailable until failover to the secondary controller completed.
business_impact: Complete payment processing outage for 75 minutes.
resolution_summary: Manual failover to secondary storage controller; database volumes remounted read-write.

history.note: Failover to secondary controller completed; payments flowing

root_causes.description: Storage controller firmware defect caused controller failure; automatic failover did not trigger.

actions.description: Fail over to secondary storage controller and validate database integrity.
Apply vendor firmware fix and test automatic failover quarterly.

rca.summary: Firmware defect in storage controller; automatic failover failed.
confirmed_facts: Controller A failed at incident start
contributing_factors: Failover not tested since last firmware upgrade

title: End-of-day reconciliation batch failed on malformed record
description: RECON_EOD_PAY aborted on a malformed currency code in the payment extract (synthetic record).
resolution_summary: Malformed record quarantined; batch rerun completed.

actions.description: Add schema validation for currency codes in the extract loader.

title: Core Banking database connectivity failures
description: Application servers intermittently unable to obtain Oracle connections (ORA-12519) after database node failover; balance enquiries and postings failing intermittently.
business_impact: Intermittent failures for balance enquiries and ledger postings; payments retried.
resolution_summary: Restored previous listener process limit and restarted listener on both nodes.

history.description: Listener log shows connection limit reached after CHG-2030.

change_links.notes: Listener connection limit lowered by this change.

root_causes.description: CHG-2030 lowered listener process limit below peak connection demand after failover.

actions.description: Restore listener process limit to baseline value.
Add connection-capacity check to the database change review checklist.

title: Customers unable to log in - SSO token validation failures
description: Login failures (HTTP 401) for a subset of customers after the SSO library upgrade; token signature validation rejected keys after scheduled key rotation.
business_impact: Approx. 30% of synthetic login attempts failing on digital channels.
resolution_summary: Configured SSO library to refresh JWKS keys on rotation; cache flushed.

history.note: JWKS cache refresh fixed; library config corrected

title: Month-end reporting queries running slowly
description: Finance dashboard queries exceeding 60 s; warehouse CPU at 95% during ETL overlap.
resolution_summary: Rescheduled overlapping ETL aggregation jobs; CHG-2042 raised for permanent fix.

title: Regulatory report generation timing out
description: Liquidity report job exceeded its 2-hour window; same ETL contention pattern as earlier this week.
business_impact: Regulatory report submission at risk if not completed by cut-off (synthetic).
resolution_summary: Report re-run successfully after ETL jobs completed.

title: Payment API returning HTTP 500 errors after release 2.4.1
description: Synthetic monitoring and APM show HTTP 500 responses on POST /payments/authorise rising from a 0.2% baseline to 18% approximately 30 minutes after release 2.4.1. p95 latency increased from 350 ms to 4.2 s. Payment authorisation throughput has dropped by roughly 60%.
business_impact: Customer payments are failing or delayed across mobile and online banking. Downstream reconciliation and customer transaction status services are affected.

history.note: Bridge call opened; release team engaged

history.description: APM: 500 errors concentrated on /payments/authorise; stack traces show 'ConnectionPoolTimeoutException: no connection available within 3000 ms'.
DB metrics: active connections pinned at new pool max (20, previously 100); fraud-scoring call adds ~900 ms while holding a DB connection.
Deployment of CHG-2041 (v2.4.1) occurred 30 minutes before error onset. Rollback is being prepared but requires emergency CAB approval.

change_links.notes: Error onset ~30 minutes after deployment; pool config changed.

root_causes.description: Connection pool maximum reduced from 100 to 20 in release 2.4.1 while the new synchronous fraud-scoring call holds connections longer, exhausting the pool under peak load.

actions.description: Prepare rollback of Payment Processing to 2.4.0 pending emergency CAB approval.

title: Intraday payments reconciliation batch failed
description: Control-M job RECON_INTRADAY_PAY ended NOTOK. The payment transaction extract was incomplete (timeouts reading from Payment Processing) causing 4,120 synthetic transactions to be unmatched.
business_impact: Intraday reconciliation position unavailable to Finance Operations; break queue growing.

history.note: Suspected dependency on Payment Processing incident

history.description: Extract step log: 'HTTP 500 from payment-api /transactions/export after 3 retries'.

title: Customer transaction status updates delayed
description: Customer Services API reports stale payment status for recent transactions; status refresh calls to Payment Processing are timing out and falling back to cached values.
business_impact: Customers see 'pending' for completed payments; contact centre volume rising.

title: Incorrect label on account summary response field
description: The account summary API returns 'availableBalanceTxt' instead of the documented field label.
business_impact: Cosmetic; channel teams have a workaround.

title: Core banking balance enquiries timing out
description: Balance enquiry p95 latency rose above 5 s during the morning peak; mobile and online banking show a spinner when customers open their accounts. Ledger postings are not affected.
business_impact: Customers cannot see balances in mobile and online banking; contact centre calls rising.

title: Card settlement file upload to card scheme failed
description: Batch SETTLEMENT_UPLOAD_VISA failed with an SFTP connection timeout to the card-scheme gateway; retries also failed. Three settlement files are waiting to be sent.
business_impact: Settlement with the card scheme is delayed; missing today's cut-off would delay merchant funding.

title: Finance dashboard showing stale intraday data
description: The intraday finance dashboard has not refreshed for over an hour; the ETL load from reconciliation was skipped.
business_impact: Treasury and finance see an out-of-date intraday liquidity position.

title: Small FX rounding differences in reconciliation report
description: 37 cross-currency items show differences below 0.01 EUR between the payment extract and the ledger; they are reported as breaks every day.
business_impact: Operations spend time clearing false breaks; no financial loss.

title: Account statement PDFs slow to generate
description: Statement download takes 25-30 s instead of 3 s; the external PDF rendering vendor reports degraded performance.
business_impact: Customers wait or retry statement downloads; no data issue.

history.description: Vendor status page: PDF rendering API degraded in EU region; ticket VND-7781 raised.
